title: CV AI runtime context
description: Built by the app from the 3 router questions + seniority + the CV. Drives block selection. Persisted on the session so Phase 1 (score) and Phase 2 (rebuild) read identical selections.

mode.description: Which phase. Same persona_profile is used for both.

router.description: Raw answers from the pre-analysis questions.

target_sector.description: Free text; mapped to a sector overlay by the selector.

target_region.description: Used to infer domestic vs multinational together with company signal.

seniority.description: EXPLICIT. Never inferred by the model. Either asked as a 4th tap or derived deterministically from current_title in code.

company_type_hint.description: Optional explicit signal; if unknown the selector infers from region + sector.

persona_profile.description: OUTPUT of the selector. The single source of truth. Persisted and reused across both phases — never re-derived in Phase 2.

cv.description: The candidate's current CV, pre-parsed into structured fields by the app before the model sees it.

sections.description: Optional pre-parsed sections if your parser produces them.
